shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -4 --oneline
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md
sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo 'no reanchor script'; fi
if [ -f scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs ]; then node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; fi
git diff --check
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "chore: repair issue 95 CI findings" && git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
